question: G started walking straight from a point X. He turned 3 times right during his journey. Finally, he is facing towards west. In which direction he started walking from X? (He took no left turn)
solution:
**Given:** G started walking straight from a point X. He turned 3 times right during his journey. Finally, he is facing towards west.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/356c2ed7f5c669ba2a92b3a6bf102a0fe29fb1e9db3fa487261a024c8922fa28.png] 

Thus, he started from North direction.
